rule: Every Kano-specific workaround for a missing shared-engine feature is declared here with the docs/ROAD_ENGINE_BACKLOG.md item that removes it and a DATA-ONLY removal path. KanoSliceTests fails if a placement is neither a declared workaround nor a declared set piece, or if a removal needs code.

workarounds.what: A 4.5 m open front apron (drain slab, walkway, pole line) inside each plot prefab
workarounds.isolation: the apron is the separate Blender kit module `kit_apron_drain`; each plot is exported twice from one source, with the apron and as `<id>_noapron`; the no-apron variants are catalogued only when the engine has kerb and drain strips
workarounds.removalPath: in the route rules replace each plot prop id by its `_noapron` variant and move the offset 4.5 m towards the road (data only)

workarounds.what: Side-street plots as hand-placed set pieces (the scatter runs along the main road only)
workarounds.removalPath: delete the `side_*` placements and add scatter rules for the side corridors (data only)

workarounds.what: Median double streetlights as hand-placed set pieces (rule offsets only go outward from the formation edge)
workarounds.removalPath: replace the placements with a median rule (data only)

workarounds.what: The word KANO baked into the gantry sign prefab (production prefabs get no text)
workarounds.removalPath: point the placement at the text-bearing sign prefab; the placement already carries the text (data only)

workarounds.what: Staggered T-junctions at least 150 m apart instead of four-way crossings
workarounds.removalPath: replace a staggered pair by one four-way junction in the route data (data only)

notWorkarounds: Parked vehicles grouped into single meshes: a draw-call optimisation that stays valid under any engine.
The existing 'damaged' and 'worn' surface classes: used as they are, nothing Kano-specific added (RB-06 is future work).
